title: Overview of predictmeans
text: Mixed Effects Models: Essential statistical analysis (e.g., split-plot experiments, repeated measurements, meta-analysis). However, popular R packages like ‘nlme’ ‘lme4’ provide model effects ANOVA outputs, lacking inference (predicted means, multiple comparisons, confidence intervals). Permutation Tests: Ideal small sample sizes, non-normal distributions, parametric test assumptions unmet. offer robust flexible hypothesis testing scenarios. Semiparametric Regression: Combines parametric non-parametric effects predictive variables. Widely valuable across astronomy, biology, medicine, economics, finance applications. Package ‘predictmeans’: Offers diagnostic inference functions various models (‘aov’, ‘lm’, ‘glm’, etc.). Inferences include predicted means, standard errors, contrasts, multiple comparisons, permutation tests, adjusted R-square, graphical representations. https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/predictmeans/index.html.

text: model Model object returned aov, lm, glm, gls, lme, lmer, glmer, glmmTMB, gam/bam (package mgcv; gamm use $gam component) semireg. modelterm Name ("quotes") indicating model term's predicted mean calculated. modelterm must given exactly appears printed model, e.g. "" ":B". factor created model formula, e.g. factor(dose), can given either "factor(dose)" "dose". covariate numerical vector specify values covariates calculating predicted means, default values means associated covariates. also can name one covariates model, case predictions made range values covariates (see covariateV). semireg model may also covariate appears smooth terms. covariateV Values covariate(s) named covariate. one covariate, numeric vector. several covariates, either list numeric vectors (combinations used) matrix one named column per covariate, row one prediction point (e.g. set locations two-dimensional smooth). covariateV NULL, 50 (one covariate) 30 (several covariates) equally spaced values observed range used. data cases, need provide data set used model fitting, example data used fit model can longer found. Usually data recovered model. prtnum option printing covariate info screen . default FALSE. cov_reduce covariates varied handled. function returning single value, applied covariate (default mean; median another choice), string "average", averages predictions observed values covariates instead fixing one value. "average", nonlinear terms poly(x, 2) s(x) averaged data, gam gives predicted means adjusted (rather evaluated centre ) spatial temporal trend. exclude gam models : labels smooth terms leave predictions (columns K set zero), e.g. "s(Block)". default NULL excludes random-effect smooths (bs = "re" bs = "fs"), predicted means population-level means, lmer. Use exclude = character(0) keep smooth terms. weights cells factors modelterm weighted averaging : "equal" (default; equal weights), "proportional" (weights proportional frequencies cells data, every mean, SAS LSMEANS / OM), "outer" (products factor's frequencies), "cells" (mean weights cells frequencies) "flat" (equal weights non-empty cells). definitions emmeans.

what: R-squared for Mixed Models as Numbers — R2_model
title: R-squared for Mixed Models as Numbers — R2_model
text: R-squared mixed model numeric result. method = "piepho" (default) gives values R2_glmm (Piepho, 2023), proportions: total, fixed, random random-effect component. method = "nakagawa" gives marginal (fixed effects) conditional (fixed random effects) R-squared Nakagawa Schielzeth (2013), random slopes Johnson (2014): variance random-effect term mean \(z_i' \Sigma z_i\) observations.

title: R-squared for Mixed Models as Numbers — R2_model
code: R2_model(model, method = c("piepho", "nakagawa"), over_disp = FALSE)

title: R-squared for Mixed Models as Numbers — R2_model
text: model model fitted lmer, glmer glmmTMB. method "piepho" "nakagawa". over_disp "piepho": R2_glmm.

title: R-squared for Mixed Models as Numbers — R2_model
text: named numeric vector proportions (class "pm_r2", printed percentages). "nakagawa", Marginal Conditional, attribute "variances": fixed-effect, random-effect observation-level variances.

title: R-squared for Mixed Models as Numbers — R2_model
text: "nakagawa" observation-level variance residual variance gaussian models variance latent distribution binomial models: \(\pi^2/3\) (logit), 1 (probit) \(\pi^2/6\) (cloglog). families several competing approximations; use method = "piepho" .

title: R-squared for Mixed Models as Numbers — R2_model

(2014), Extension Nakagawa & Schielzeth's R2GLMM random slopes models, Methods Ecology Evolution, 5, 944-946.

title: Plots and Summary of Predicted Means — autoplot.predictmeans
text: object result predictmeans. type "means" (default) plots predicted means; "pvalue" heatmap adjusted pairwise p-values (within level atvar given); "response" back-transformed means. interval Bars around means: confidence limits ("ci", default), half average LSD ("lsd"; means whose bars overlap differ significantly LSDs equal), none. digits Number significant digits printed (plus two). x result summary(). ... used.

text: Build standard family contrasts among means model term, matrix ctrmatrix argument contrastmeans. families emmeans, coefficients names: "pairwise", "revpairwise" pairs, earlier minus later level (later minus earlier); "trt.vs.ctrl" level minus reference level ref (Dunnett's comparisons; use   adj = "mvt" contrastmeans exact Dunnett adjustment); "consec" level minus one ; "poly" orthogonal polynomials (linear, quadratic, ...) integer coefficients, equally spaced   levels; "eff" level minus average levels; "del.eff" level minus average levels. , family built within level (combination levels) factor(s), atvar pairwise comparisons. Note contrastmeans adjusts p-values rows one family.

title: Families of Contrasts among Means — contrast_family
code: contrast_family(.x, family = c("pairwise", "revpairwise", "trt.vs.ctrl", "consec", "poly",                 "eff", "del.eff"), ref = 1, by = NULL, max.degree = NULL)

title: Families of Contrasts among Means — contrast_family
text: .x Kmatrix predictmeans result model term, character vector level names (used). family family contrasts (see Description). ref "trt.vs.ctrl": reference level, position name (within group), default first level. Optional name(s) factor(s) term: build family within levels. max.degree "poly": highest degree, default number levels - 1 (6).

title: Families of Contrasts among Means — contrast_family
text: matrix one row per contrast (named emmeans, e.g. "0.2 - 0", "linear"; group comes first, e.g. "Victory: 0.2 - 0") one column per level term. Levels whose means estimated left families.

title: Linear Contrast Tests for a Linear Model — contrastmeans
text: model Model object returned aov, lm, glm, gls, lme, lmer. modelterm Name ("quotes") indicating factor term's contrast calculated. modelterm must given exactly appears printed model, e.g. "" ":B". ctrmatrix specified contrast matrix. ctrmatrix missing, programe ask user enter . columns can named level (e.g. specify_contrast); levels given get zero weight. ctrnames Names specified contrasts, e.g. c("vs D", "C vs B", ...) adj Name ("quote") indicating method adjusting p-values pairwise comparisons. choices "none", "holm", "hochberg", "hommel", "bonferroni", "BH", "", "fdr", "sidak", "scheffe" "mvt", letter case. "sidak", "scheffe" (rank ctrmatrix) "mvt" (single-step multivariate t, exact counterpart SAS ADJUST=SIMULATE; needs package mvtnorm) emmeans. default method "none". Df denominator degree freedom modelterm. (glmer models Df needs specified, models, Df obtained fitted model automatically). permlist model parameter list containing nsim parameters produced function permmodels. permlist != NULL, option Df non-functional. key option permutation test. vcov_adjust lmer models fitted REML: TRUE (default), standard errors use Kenward-Roger adjusted covariance matrix fixed effects, SAS DDFM=KR emmeans , go Kenward-Roger degrees freedom. FALSE uses unadjusted covariance reproduces results predictmeans 1.x. effect models. weights Passed Kmatrix: cells factors modelterm weighted averaging ("equal", default, "proportional", "outer", "cells" "flat"). df_method Denominator df lmer models: "auto" (Kenward-Roger REML fits, Satterthwaite ML fits), "Kenward-Roger", "Satterthwaite" "containment" (SAS DDFM=CONTAIN; see predictmeans).

code: library(predictmeans)   # A made-up model class that wraps lm() and has only four methods.   fit_mymodel <- function(formula, data) {     structure(list(fit = lm(formula, data), call = match.call()), class = "mymodel")   }   coef.mymodel <- function(object, ...) coef(object$fit)   vcov.mymodel <- function(object, ...) vcov(object$fit)   terms.mymodel <- function(x, ...) terms(x$fit)   df.residual.mymodel <- function(object, ...) object$fit$df.residual    Oats <- as.data.frame(nlme::Oats)   Oats$nitro <- factor(Oats$nitro)   m <- fit_mymodel(yield ~ Block + nitro*Variety, data = Oats)   predictmeans(m, "nitro", plot = FALSE)$means #> Error in x$terms %||% attr(x, "terms") %||% stop("no terms component nor attribute"): no terms component nor attribute    # Degrees of freedom of its own, e.g. normal-based:   pm_df.mymodel <- function(model, L, ...) rep(Inf, nrow(L))   predictmeans(m, "nitro", plot = FALSE)$means #> Error in x$terms %||% attr(x, "terms") %||% stop("no terms component nor attribute"): no terms component nor attribute

code: library(predictmeans) Oats$nitro <- factor(Oats$nitro)  fm <- lmer(yield ~ nitro*Variety+(1|Block/Variety), data=Oats) if (FALSE) varcomp(fm) # \dontrun{} fm1 <- lme(yield ~ nitro*Variety, random=~1|Block/Variety, data=Oats) varcomp(fm1) #>                                      vcov        SE     lower     upper #> Block.Block.var((Intercept))     214.4745 168.83242  45.84595 1003.3449 #> Variety.Variety.var((Intercept)) 106.0618  67.87554  30.25561  371.8022 #> sigma_sq                         177.0835  37.33248 117.14643  267.6870  data(Orthodont, package="nlme") mod <- lmer(distance ~ age + (age|Subject), data=Orthodont) if (FALSE) varcomp(mod) # \dontrun{} mod1 <- lme(distance ~ age, random=~age|Subject, data=Orthodont) varcomp(mod1) #>                                             vcov        SE       lower #> Subject.Subject.var((Intercept))      5.41508791 4.9583411  0.89986361 #> Subject.Subject.cov(age,(Intercept)) -0.32106066 0.4243794 -0.49433350 #> Subject.Subject.var(age)              0.05126955 0.0414508  0.01051371 #> sigma_sq                              1.71620400 0.3302836  1.17675496 #>                                           upper #> Subject.Subject.var((Intercept))     32.5862463 #> Subject.Subject.cov(age,(Intercept))  0.1568360 #> Subject.Subject.var(age)              0.2500132 #> sigma_sq                              2.5029477

what: Changes that affect results or scripts
title: predictmeans 1.1.1.9000 (development version)
text: Kenward-Roger adjusted standard errors now default lmer models fitted REML, predictmeans() contrastmeans() (vcov_adjust = TRUE). matches SAS DDFM=KR emmeans. Standard errors, confidence limits, SEDs, LSDs p-values can differ slightly predictmeans 1.x (e.g. 7.896 instead 7.887 unbalanced Oats example); balanced designs barely change. Use vcov_adjust = FALSE reproduce 1.x results. glmmTMB longer attached library(predictmeans); moved Depends Imports. Scripts fit models glmmTMB() need library(glmmTMB). lme4, nlme lmerTest still attached. permmodels() gives tables (including Satterthwaite df p-values) whether lmer model fitted lme4::lmer() lmerTest::lmer(). glmer Poisson models now give back-transformed means counts (whole numbers, never zero), glm glmmTMB Poisson models already . semipred() limits now two-sided stated level: default level = 0.05 gives 95% limits. Earlier versions used qnorm(1 - level), .e. 90% limits default; level = 0.1 gives limits. predictmeans(letterCI = TRUE) now works atvar: CI-overlap letters compare means within atvar group (predictmeans 1.1.2). , atvar dropped letters compared means. note mean table now says letters come overlap , e.g., 83.4% CIs, gives approximate test level (0.05), instead “significant level ‘0.166’”. level keeps meaning (sets CIs). two atvar factors note one line (“level :B”) instead two.

title: predictmeans 1.1.1.9000 (development version)
text: means: one row per mean, estimate, std.error, df, conf.low, conf.high, back-transformed response columns, group letters, n estimable; pairs: one row per comparison, level1, level2, (atvar), estimate, std.error, df, statistic, p.value, p.adj, lsd p.method; settings. checked emmeans tests. legacy slots printed output unchanged, result class c("predictmeans", "pdmlist"). coef() vcov() predictmeans() result give means (model scale) covariance matrix, Kenward-Roger adjusted means (equal emmeans’ vcov()). contrast means can tested multcomp::glht() marginaleffects::hypotheses(), e.g. hypotheses(pm, hypothesis = "pairwise") (marginaleffects Suggests; predictmeans registers get_coef/set_coef/get_vcov methods; recent marginaleffects versions also need options(marginaleffects_model_classes = "predictmeans")).

text: New specify_contrast() writes contrasts level names instead counted columns, e.g. specify_contrast(Kmatrix(fm, ":B"), = (x:b1+y:b1)/2 -z:b1). result goes straight contrastmeans(ctrmatrix = ). checks weights sum zero (unless .zero_sum = FALSE) missing non-estimable mean used. accepts contrast matrix whose columns named level, order subset levels; keeps contrast names result; gains weights.

title: predictmeans 1.1.1.9000 (development version)
text: New bootmodels(): parametric bootstrap p-values terms coefficients lmer glmer models, simulating model without fixed effects (global null) refitting. result can passed predictmeans() contrastmeans() permlist, giving bootstrap p-values pairwise comparisons contrasts (p.method "bootstrap" pairs table). semipred(simultaneous = TRUE) gives simultaneous confidence bands whole curve(s), difference curves contr (Ruppert, Wand Carroll): critical value quantile largest standardised deviation 10,000 draws, fixed seed results repeat (user’s random numbers left alone). predictmeans() accepts semireg() fits: means factor term include smooth terms (fixed part plus smooth’s random effects, semipred()), covariates’ means named covariate values, pairwise comparisons (normal-based, adj), letters, coef()/vcov(). result holds means, pairs settings tables. semipred()’s design step now internal function shared (output unchanged). New R2_model(): R-squared mixed model numbers (class "pm_r2", printed percentages). method = "piepho" (default) gives values R2_glmm() proportions; method = "nakagawa" gives Nakagawa Schielzeth’s marginal conditional R-squared, random slopes Johnson (2014), gaussian binomial models (sleepstudy: 0.279 0.799, performance::r2_nakagawa()). R2_glmm() unchanged. New pm_slopes(): slope numeric covariate within level factor term, SEs, df, confidence limits tests, pairwise comparisons slopes (adj). Equal emmeans’ emtrends() (Kenward-Roger lmer); poly() splines slope taken (default: covariate’s mean) central difference. Response scale: means back-transformed (non-identity link trans), means table response.std.error (delta method, equal emmeans type = "response"). log link trans = exp, pairs table ratio means confidence limits (ratio, ratio.conf.low, ratio.conf.high); logit link, odds ratio (odds.ratio, …). limits use df differences. New pm_joint(): F tests sets contrasts among means term. , means compared within level factor(s), SAS SLICE (e.g. nitrogen within variety); ctrmatrix, set contrasts tested together. lmer: Kenward-Roger F test equal pbkrtest::KRmodcomp(), Satterthwaite equal lmerTest::contest(joint = TRUE), containment df; nlme df lme; residual df otherwise. New contrast_family() builds standard families contrasts among means term contrastmeans(): "pairwise", "revpairwise", "trt.vs.ctrl" (Dunnett; exact adj = "mvt"), "consec", "poly" (integer orthogonal polynomials), "eff" "del.eff", optionally within level factors. Coefficients names emmeans’; results contrastmeans() equal emmeans’ contrast(). New adj methods predictmeans() contrastmeans(): "sidak", "scheffe" "mvt", emmeans (equal emmeans’ p-values sidak scheffe; within 1e-3 mvt). "mvt" single-step multivariate t adjustment, exact counterpart SAS ADJUST=SIMULATE; needs mvtnorm (Suggests), uses fixed seed results repeat, leaves user’s random numbers . Scheffe rank number means - 1 pairs (within atvar group) rank ctrmatrix contrastmeans(). permlist "sidak" three allowed. Kmatrix(), predictmeans() covariatemeans() gain weights = c("equal", "proportional", "outer", "cells", "flat"), sets cells factors modelterm weighted. "proportional" uses observed frequencies, every mean, like SAS LSMEANS / OM. definitions emmeans’, results match emmeans. default "equal" unchanged. predictmeans(vcov_adjust = TRUE) contrastmeans(vcov_adjust = TRUE): lmer models fitted REML, standard errors use Kenward-Roger adjusted covariance (SAS DDFM=KR emmeans ) go Kenward-Roger df. default keeps earlier, unadjusted standard errors. predictmeans() covariatemeans() pass cov_reduce exclude Kmatrix(). example, cov_reduce = "average" gives gam means adjusted spatial smooth.

title: predictmeans 1.1.1.9000 (development version)
text: predictmeans() covariatemeans() ignored trans glm glmmTMB models identity link: gaussian glmmTMB(log(y) ~ ...) trans = exp showed back-transformed means. trans now used whenever link identity; models another link still use inverse. back-transformed plots predictmeans() covariatemeans(), data points shifted transOff response transformed modelling (e.g. column holding log(y + 1), transOff = 1), sat transOff means. glmmTMB models correlated random effects, e.g. (Days | Subject), random-effect variance wrong (84.32% instead 78.71% lmer gives sleepstudy) slope missing breakdown. glmmTMB puts correlations scale, covariance now built VarCorr(); breakdown term split correlated term’s columns two halves instead component (lmer ). component (intercept, slope) now gets share; covariance random-effect total. Models without correlated terms unchanged; failed glmmTMB models random effects zero-inflation part, coefficients dropped aliased; over_disp = TRUE finds observation-level random effect wherever formula (glmmTMB keeps formula’s order). SEs variances wrong: converting SDs used derivative 0.5/sqrt(sd) instead 0.5/sd (0.2845 instead 0.2280 cbpp example; glmmTMB gives 0.2294), covariances ignored dependence two SDs. vcov_glmerMod(ranpar = "var") now applies delta method full Jacobian; failed models one variance parameter, e.g. (Days | Subject) (“invalid ‘row.names’ length”). letterCI help says CI overlap matches pairwise tests finds fewer differences, reference (Maghsoodloo Huang, 2010; 1.1.2 help). modelterm factors another order letter case: 'Variety:nitro' term model. mean 'nitro:Variety'?; otherwise message lists model’s terms; misspelled adj lists valid choices (, p.adjust() gave error mention "tukey"). adj may given letter case, e.g. "Tukey" "bh", predictmeans() contrastmeans(). contrastmeans() help longer lists "tukey", never supported. failed glmmTMB models coefficients dropped aliased; “random effects vs fitted” panel glmer glmmTMB models correlated term, e.g. (Days | Subject), random effects matched wrong columns Z (ranef() lists component, Z level). ci_mcp() stopped lower upper limit equal (mean SE 0). internal model.matrix() method lme models accepts data =. varcomp() glmmTMB models gave wrong confidence limits (upper limit estimate), read correlation parameters log standard deviations, residual variance. now gives table lmer: variances covariances term (zero-inflation terms prefixed zi.), residual variance gaussian models, delta-method SEs (equal lmer ones sleepstudy), Wald CIs log scale variances Fisher z scale correlations. ci = FALSE now works models. semireg_tmb() predict_info = TRUE: random-effect covariance wrong correlated terms (cause R2_glmm()). singular covariance detected without computing eigenvalues, system positive definite falls back nearPD() instead failing. contrastmeans() failed “non-conformable arguments” every model missing treatment combination, even contrasts involve . now works, stops clear message contrast uses mean estimated. Tukey-adjusted p-values within atvar levels used number pairs instead number means. 4 means per level, Tukey computed 6 means, p-values large (0.350 instead 0.197 Oats example). lmer models also used one averaged df instead pair’s df. now match emmeans. predictmeans() failed every lmer model missing treatment combination (“replacement 12 rows, data 11”). predictmeans() failed lmer models fitted ML (REML = FALSE). Satterthwaite df now used fits, message; df_term() falls back Satterthwaite warning instead stopping. permmodels() CookD() refitted lme/gls models re-evaluating model call inside package. Data fitted inside function found, data set name elsewhere search path used silently. example, local Oats nitro factor replaced nlme::Oats, permutation tests different model. Refits now use model’s data check reproduce coefficients. Kmatrix(), predictmeans(), permmodels() CookD() now find data gls models fitted inside function; nlme::getData() . CookD() failed every lmer model: refitted ML asked Kenward-Roger df, needs REML. now works agrees lme. permmodels() failed gls models without correlation structure. glmmTMB models now finds data global environment; over_disp = TRUE gives clear message model observation-level random effect. passing two deprecated mplot, barplot, pplot, bkplot arguments gave error instead deprecation warning; trans = NULL gave error. contrastmeans() permlist counted permuted statistics strictly greater observed one. now counts “greater equal” (rounding), predictmeans() , give permutation p-value contrast. predictmeans(), contrastmeans() permmodels() longer leave options(scipen = 6) set return; printed results look . contrastmeans() without ctrmatrix opens contrast editor interactive session. semipred() failed (“replacement 0 rows”) semireg() fits whose data numeric variable prediction grid, numeric grouping id (1 | idnum), tried undo centring grid .

title: predictmeans 1.1.1.9000 (development version)
text: Satterthwaite df (used lmer models fitted ML, df_term(type = "Satterthwaite")) computed contrasts ingredients computed per model. equal lmerTest’s values, 25x faster many contrasts (780 pairs: 0.8 s -> 0.03 s), longer convert model lmerTest’s class. Kenward-Roger computations longer form invert n x n covariance data. use model’s low-rank structure (Woodbury identity), results pbkrtest. n = 3,000 takes 0.05 s instead 21.5 s; n = 20,000 takes 0.3 s (previously reach). Kenward-Roger df computed contrasts (identical pbkrtest::Lb_ddf() row row), adjusted covariance computed per predictmeans() call instead per model term, means, pairs. predictmeans() lmer models 10-50x faster: Oats split-plot 0.96 s -> 0.09 s; 40 means 780 pairwise comparisons 5.3 s -> 0.1 s. permmodels() longer computes Kenward-Roger df every permutation refit (df discarded). 10x faster lmer models (99 permutations Oats split-plot: 21.8 s -> 2.2 s), identical permutation p-values. permmodels() permlmer() use sparse Cholesky factor triangular solves instead dense n x n inverse. Letter groups (multcompLetters(), used letters) much faster many means, identical letters (checked 375 random cases): 100 means 4.1 s -> 0.3 s; 200 means 103 s -> 2.1 s. “absorb” step now checks letter columns changed. permmodels() lmer models takes t values refit covariance matrix already , instead calling summary(), computed : 15-20% faster (300 permutations Oats split-plot, type III: 4.3 s -> 3.5 s), identical results. nine copies per-refit code now one internal function. R2_glmm() computes traces without n x n matrices. n = 4,000 goes 4.4 s 529 MB 0.01 s identical results; n = 100,000 now takes 0.02 s.

what: Bug fixes found by the refactor
title: predictmeans 1.1.1.9000 (development version)
text: predictmeans() permlist atvar failed “undefined columns selected”. now gives permutation p-values within atvar level. Factor levels containing ":" (e.g. "Golden:Rain") broke legacy pairwise tables: atvar failed within-factor SEDs LSDs computed misread labels (B4). Level labels now taken label table, never split row names. user-supplied Df lmer model gave NA p-values pairs first (“missing value TRUE/FALSE needed” letters computed). given Df now used every pair.

title: predictmeans 1.1.1.9000 (development version)
text: Letter groups, overall within atvar groups, now come one function (pm_letter_groups()) handles unavailable p-values (missing levels non-estimable differences) way everywhere. Fixes repeated errors letters missing p-values, error mean/SE tables non-estimable means meet empty cells. Pairwise differences now checked estimability, means: confounded factors (e.g. one volume used fine droplets) difference depends dropped coefficient NA instead computed coefficient taken 0. Letters given means whose comparisons can estimated, message non-estimable means suggests weights = "cells". Fixes error (“missing value TRUE/FALSE needed”) letters. lmerTest::ranova() gaussian semireg() fit failed (“object ‘grp_geo’ found”), refits treated remaining smooth terms ordinary random intercepts. Gaussian semireg() fits now class semerLmerTest, whose update() refits semireg() smooth bases. smoothZ may also list given name. New data set copper (used overview article). deprecated plot arguments (mplot, barplot/bar, pplot, bkplot) turned every plot given, bar = TRUE gave NULL mean plot. Plots given now keep .plots setting, deprecation warning shows equivalent .plots call. Fixed (regression development version): nested treatments one observation per block cell (e.g. treat/contcomp repl), means averaged structurally empty cells wrong. Empty cells now judged factors interact . atvar several factors failed (“Names required”) group atvar levels one observed level factors, (“replacement 8 rows, data 12”) group one level. Within-atvar comparisons: adjusted p-values assigned wrong group pair groups row order (example two atvar factors, empty groups). came 1.x. P-values letters now matched groups levels name. examples permmodels(), permlmer(), permanova.lmer(), semireg(), semireg_tmb() semipred(), lmer example residplot(), run (commented ). Permutation examples use 99 permutations one core; slow parts \donttest{}, examples HRW data run HRW installed. semireg_tmb() example longer passes resp_scale, semireg() ; sleepstudy plot uses ggplot2 instead latticeExtra. Three vignettes: “Getting started predictmeans”, “Adjusted R² generalized linear mixed models” “Migrating predictmeans 1.x”. pkgdown website (built GitHub Actions published GitHub Pages), two longer worked-example articles: overview package experimental design analysis tree improvement. semireg_tmb() works glmmTMB >= 1.1.12, longer stores Lambdat, Lind lower (rebuilt missing). R2_glmm() failed gaussian glmmTMB fits (including semireg_tmb()) glmmTMB >= 1.1.12, whose dispersion parameter named betadisp; fixed effects now come fixef(model)$cond. New data sets Body_length Poisson_ind (used R² vignette).

title: predictmeans 1.1.1.9000 (development version)
text: enter transformations: poly(), ns(), bs(), log(), scale(), (); appear inside interactions (:x without x, x:z); mgcv smooth terms (s(), te(), s(x, = )). cases previously stopped “subscript bounds” “object found”. Kmatrix() predictmeans() now support mgcv::gam()/bam() models, using lpmatrix smooths. Random-effect smooths (bs = "re", bs = "fs") excluded default (exclude argument). New Kmatrix() argument cov_reduce: fix covariates summary function (default mean, e.g. median), use "average" average predictions observed covariate values. character logical predictors; factor(x) terms formula (modelterm may "x" "factor(x)"); models fitted without data argument; transformed response together data =. Kmatrix() returns reference grid (refgrid) flags non-estimable rows attr(K, "estimable"). matrix covariateV several covariates now used set joint prediction points, documented; previously ignored. semipred() uses Kmatrix() semireg object directly, without refitting auxiliary lm(). smooth basis averaged reference grid fixed part. result, factors modelterm, including factors smooths, averaged correctly instead causing error. covariate summary printed prtnum = TRUE now goes message(), can suppressed. Kmatrix() faster large data (4-15x 20,000-row, 360-cell model). New tests check results every case supported 1.1.1 unchanged, compare new cases emmeans mgcv.
